- s1920_paper_scalar_eq / s1920_paper_signedHull_le (the two exact fields)
- s1920_paper_linkIdentification : (s1920_paper_thetaLink D D').link_identification   [definitionally OrigXiFThetaLinkIdentification (S1895PaperO D) D' (S1920PaperC3 D), via S1527_origXiFScalarExactField + S1554_signedHull_le]
- s1920_paper_xiF_ray / s1920_paper_xiF_ray_iff / s1920_paper_xiF_core (link_identification ∧ ray membership)
- s1920_neg_abs_log_q_le_signedHull : -|Real.log ‖S1487Cand.q‖| ≤ OrigXiFSignedThetaHullLogVolume D'   [reuses s1880_xiF_inequality_abs verbatim]; strict form s1920_neg_abs_log_q_lt_signedHull [s1880_xiF_inequality_strict]
- s1920_paper_qPilotLogVolume_eq_neg_abs and s1920_paper_qPilotLogVolume_le_signedHull (same comparison on the object's own scalar)
- s1920_paperC3_le_signedHull (same via C3/S1554, cross-check)
- S1920PaperIdentifications + s1920_paperIdentifications (S1895 six-part conjunction repackaged)
- s1920_paperFaithful_xiF / s1920_paperFaithful_scalar: bundles S1895's four paper identifications with link_identification, ray, object scalar = -|log q| and the inequality — paper-level xi-f on the source-faithful object.
- s1920_s1880_bridge_impossible / s1920_s1880_no_stripEquiv (recall S1895: S1880PaperO route stays impossible).

EVIDENCE
- lake env lean -j1 EXIT=0; no errors/warnings, no sorryAx. #print axioms on all 22 theorem declarations = propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only (17 in-file, remaining 5 in _S1920AxiomAudit.lean EXIT=0).
- Aux: _S1920Consumer.lean EXIT=0 imports the olean and re-derives scalar comparison / ray / link identification from s1920_paperFaithful_xiF.
- No sorry/axiom/True/PUnit/empty arbitrary inhabitant/Nonempty gate.

FIRST MISSING: none for this chain. Inputs are only the actual D and D'; the paper Def-3.1 clause supply R is needed to form the object/C3 but its content does not enter the xi-f scalar (object scalar is -localLogMagnitude S1487Cand, cf. s1895PaperO_qPilot_eq). Not covered: S1921 (qPilot scalar equality) and the S1927 global log-Kummer/Frobenioid frontier.
